topic.title: Export and Import the Project History
topic.shortdesc: Back up all the conversations of a project in an archive, move them to another computer, or add the conversations from an archive to the project history.

body.p: In addition to exporting or importing a single conversation, you can export the entire chat history for the current project to a ZIP archive or import such an archive into a project's history. This lets you back up your conversations, move them to another computer, or share them with a colleague.

The actions are available from the History drop-down menu in the AI Positron view. When the assistant is displayed in a separate window, they are available from the menu of the More actions button (the three vertical dots button) at the top of the history panel beside the chat. The actions are unavailable while the AI is processing a request or another history operation is running. The Export project history... action is available only when the history contains conversations.

section.title: Export the Project History

ol.li: In the History menu, select Export project history....
In the file chooser, select the name and location of the ZIP archive.

section.p: The conversations are written to the archive in the background. If the operation takes a while, a progress dialog box is displayed and you can cancel the operation. Canceling does not create the archive. When the export finishes, a message tells you how many conversations were exported and where the archive was saved. If some conversations could not be read, the message tells you how many of the total conversations could not be exported.
section.note: The conversations are stored in encrypted form in the project history, but they are saved in the archive as unencrypted JSON files so they can be read on another computer. Store the archive in a location that you trust.

section.title: Import the Project History

ol.li: In the History menu, select Import project history....
In the file chooser, select the ZIP archive that contains the conversations.

section.p: The conversations are read from the archive in the background. If the operation takes a while, a progress dialog box is displayed and you can cancel the operation. Imported conversations are added to those already in the history. You can continue them like any other conversation. The import never removes or replaces existing conversations.

Conversations already in the history are skipped. Therefore, importing an archive into the project from which it was exported does not add any conversations. When the import finishes, a message tells you how many conversations were imported and how many were skipped. If all conversations in the archive are already in the history, the message tells you that nothing was imported. If you cancel the import, conversations imported previously are kept, and the message tells you how many were imported.
Archive entries that are not valid conversations are skipped. An error message is displayed if the archive cannot be opened or does not contain any conversations that can be imported.
